The '''Integrated Household Survey''' (IHS) is a survey made up of multiple other surveys in many countries including the [[UK]] . It includes about 340,000 respondents, making it the largest collection of social data in the UK after the census.<ref>[http://www.ons.gov.uk/ons/guide-method/method-quality/specific/social-and-welfare-methodology/integrated-household-survey/index.html Integrated Household Survey]</ref> The surveys it is made up of are the [[Annual Population Survey]] and the [[Living Cost and Food Survey]].
